records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total sales for the second quarter of fiscal 2024 were $124.8 million, as compared to $140.0 million in the second quarter of fiscal 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Stores that have been open for at least 13 months are included in comparable sales.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We continued to maintain our strong financial position, successfully managing our liquidity and our inventory levels, which were down 10.2% to last year's second quarter.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Customers gravitated towards promotions and lower price point goods, which signals a consumer who is carefully choosing where and how he spends his money.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Historically, and consistent with the retail industry, we have experienced seasonal fluctuations as it relates to our operating income, net income, and free cash flow.
